story.so_that: I can select a target account from a list instead of typing a UUID
story.i_want: see a dropdown of available accounts when filling out a transaction form

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Dropdown displays available accounts on form load
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user opens the transaction form When the form mounts Then a dropdown shows all available accounts with their names

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Dropdown shows account names, not UUIDs
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the accounts dropdown is displayed When a user views the dropdown options Then they see account names like 'Alice Account' not UUID strings

acceptance_criteria.criterion: User can select an account from dropdown
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the dropdown is populated with accounts When a user selects an account Then the form state is updated with the selected account UUID

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Form submission works with dropdown selection
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given a user selects an account from dropdown When they submit the form Then the transaction is created with the correct target account UUID

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Loading state shown while fetching accounts
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the form is mounting When accounts are being fetched Then a loading indicator is displayed

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Error state shown if accounts fetch fails
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the accounts fetch fails When the form is displayed Then an error message is shown and form submission is disabled

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Empty state shown if no accounts available
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given no accounts are available When the form is displayed Then a message 'No accounts available' is shown and form submission is disabled

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Account selection is required for form submission
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the form is displayed When a user attempts to submit without selecting an account Then the form validation prevents submission with error message

edge_cases.gherkin: Given a network error occurs When fetching accounts Then error message is displayed and user can retry
Given the backend returns empty accounts array When the form is displayed Then empty state is shown
Given the system has 100+ accounts When the form is displayed Then all accounts are shown (no pagination for MVP)
Given a user opens the form When viewing the dropdown Then their own account is included in the list
Given the accounts fetch takes too long When the timeout is reached Then error message is displayed
Given a user is not authenticated When they attempt to fetch accounts Then 401 error is returned
Given the database is unavailable When accounts are requested Then 500 error is returned with graceful error message

steps.description: Create GET /api/accounts endpoint in AccountsController to return list of accounts with ID and name
Create AccountListDto with Id and Name fields for API response
Add authorization check to GET /api/accounts endpoint to ensure only authenticated users can access
Add error handling to GET /api/accounts endpoint for database failures
Implement useEffect hook in TransactionForm to fetch accounts on component mount
Create dropdown component to display fetched accounts with account names
Implement loading state UI while accounts are being fetched
Implement error state UI for failed accounts fetch with error message
Implement empty state UI when no accounts are available
Update form state management to handle account selection from dropdown
Update form validation to ensure account is selected before submission
Write unit tests for GET /api/accounts endpoint
Write unit tests for TransactionForm dropdown component
Write integration tests for accounts fetch and form submission flow
Write end-to-end tests for complete user workflow of selecting account and submitting transaction

unit_tests.description: GET /api/accounts returns all accounts with correct DTO format
Dropdown component renders with fetched accounts
Dropdown displays account names not UUIDs
Selecting account updates form state with UUID
Loading state displays while fetching accounts
Error state displays on fetch failure
Empty state displays when no accounts available
Form validation passes when account is selected
Form validation fails when no account is selected

integration_tests.description: Accounts fetch on component mount with authorization
Form submission with selected account from dropdown
Error handling when accounts endpoint returns 401
Error handling when accounts endpoint returns 500

e2e_tests.description: User opens transaction form and sees accounts dropdown populated
User selects account from dropdown and submits form
Transaction is created with correct target account UUID
User sees error message when accounts fetch fails
User sees empty state when no accounts available

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Accounts list could be very large (>1000 accounts) causing performance issues
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: For MVP, assume reasonable account count (<100). Add pagination or search in future iteration if needed. Monitor performance with real data.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Network latency could cause poor UX while fetching accounts
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Implement clear loading state, add timeout handling, consider caching accounts on frontend in future iteration

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Authorization bypass if endpoint check is missed
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Ensure authorization middleware is applied to GET /api/accounts endpoint, add security-focused unit tests

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Form submission could fail if selected account becomes invalid between fetch and submission
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Backend already validates target account exists before transaction creation, so invalid selection will be caught and rejected

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Stale accounts list if accounts are added/removed while user has form open
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: For MVP, accept stale data. User can refresh form to get latest accounts. Add real-time updates in future if needed.
Use accessible React select component with proper ARIA labels, test with keyboard navigation
